model-value.desc: Model of the component; use v-model directive

val.desc: The actual value of the option with which model value is changed

label.desc: Label to display along the radio control

left-label.desc: Label should be displayed on the left side

color.desc: Color name from the Quasar Color Palette

size.desc: Size in CSS units or standard size name (xs|sm|md|lg|xl)

dark.desc: Notify the component that the background is a dark color

default.desc: Default slot can be used as label, unless 'label' prop is specified

update:model-value.desc: Emitted when the component needs to change the model; used by v-model
